response.sql: WITH eq_avg AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum FROM scanenvironment WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY equipref), ref AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS overall_avg FROM eq_avg), above AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_hum FROM eq_avg e CROSS JOIN ref r WHERE e.avg_hum > r.overall_avg), grp AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS group_mean FROM above) SELECT a.equipref AS equip_ref, a.avg_hum AS avg_humidity, a.avg_hum - r.overall_avg AS excess_over_overall, a.avg_hum - g.group_mean AS diff_from_group_mean FROM above a CROSS JOIN ref r CROSS JOIN grp g WHERE r.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND g.group_mean IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
